findings.title: Encoded JSON compact manifests bypass payload validation
findings.description: envelope() checks UTF-8 byte markers, storage keys and ASCII escape bytes before json.loads. UTF-16/32 encoded JSON manifests lack those byte sequences and return None, so shared availability and budget validation treat them as plain evidence without decoding or checking their payload. A missing-payload manifest can therefore satisfy evidence availability, violating the lossless storage policy's fail-closed proof guarantee. Independently confirmed by static control-flow inspection following the SECURITY reviewer's executable finding.
findings.required_change: Classify supported JSON encodings before applying reserved-field detection, or reject encoded reserved storage records. Add regressions for UTF-16/32 encoded manifests with missing/corrupt payloads and command/tested/exit mismatch, including availability, retrieval, budget and M3 metadata-count paths. Preserve genuine historical plain evidence.
